name: Eastgate Car Park
address: Eastgate, Bondi Junction (enter via Ebley Street or Newland Street)
hours: 5AM to 11.30PM daily; closed Good Friday, Easter Sunday and Christmas Day
research: Rates from the car parks page and the same figures in Waverley's Pricing Policy Fees & Charges 2026-2027 (https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/media/documents/council/operational_plans_and_fees_and_charges/Pricing_policy_fees_and_charges.pdf). First hour free; leave for at least 30 minutes for another free hour on same-day re-entry; a 30-minute gap is needed to move to the Library car park. Late bird: the web page says 'Night rate (6pm–9pm) $12.80 flat' and the fees PDF says 'Late bird Parking (6pm to close)'. Recorded as entry 6pm–9pm, leave by closing (11.30pm). All-day $19.80 is rooftop level only. Overnight costs $42.00 per night on top of parking fees. Major Event Parking $23.60 applies on advertised days only (not recorded). Lost ticket $43.00. Monthly $365.00. Licence plate recognition is used. The fees PDF lists a card surcharge on car parks (0.8%, 1 July–30 Sept 2026).
note: First hour free. Wait 30 minutes before coming back for another free hour. The $19.80 all-day rate is for the rooftop only. Overnight stays cost $42 a night on top. Closed Good Friday, Easter Sunday and Christmas Day.

name: Queen Elizabeth Drive Carpark
research: Fees PDF section 20.4: 'Bondi Beach long term beach parking – Queen Elizabeth Drive and Park Drive North $12.40 hourly fee'. The parking meters page (https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/residents/parking/parking_meters) says meters on Queen Elizabeth Drive and Park Drive North and South switch off at 7pm; start time not published, hence arrival window 0–19. Billing increment not published (recorded per hour). No daily maximum or time limit published for non-permit holders. Beach parking permit holders park unlimited in these metered spaces. Pay by coin, card, contactless, Pay by Plate or Park'nPay; no tickets printed. Kerb's Waverley parking survey shows these as 4-hour meters from 7am to 7pm (P240 at Park Drive North), so arrivals from 7am to 7pm pay, with a 4-hour limit, and the meters are off after 7pm. Arrive before 7am and you pay from 7am.
note: Beach parking. Meters run 7am to 7pm with a 4-hour limit. Beach permit holders park free.

name: Park Drive Carpark
research: Fees PDF section 20.4 splits Park Drive: 'Queen Elizabeth Drive and Park Drive North $12.40 hourly fee' (all year); 'Bondi Beach – Park Drive South – Summer Rate – Sept to May $12.40'; 'Park Drive South – Winter Rate – June to August $7.30'. It is not clear whether this record is North or South. $12.40 is correct for both from September to May (now). In June–August Park Drive South is $7.30/h; the schema has no season field. Meters switch off at 7pm (https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/residents/parking/parking_meters); start time and billing increment not published. Kerb's Waverley parking survey shows these as 4-hour meters from 7am to 7pm (P240 at Park Drive North), so arrivals from 7am to 7pm pay, with a 4-hour limit, and the meters are off after 7pm. Arrive before 7am and you pay from 7am.
note: Beach parking. Meters run 7am to 7pm with a 4-hour limit. Park Drive South drops to $7.30 an hour from June to August. Beach permit holders park free.
